# AESTETIK

> AESTETIK (AutoEncoder for Spatial Transcriptomics Expression with Topology and Image Knowledge) is a convolutional autoencoder that jointly integrates transcriptomics and morphology information to learn accurate spot representations for spatial transcriptomics data.

## Key Facts

- Learns multi-modal spot representations from spatial transcriptomics and H&E morphology
- Integrates spatial topology, gene expression, and tissue morphology in a single model
- Supports cross-sample integration using Harmony, scVI, etc.
- Won 1st place at Mammoth International Contest On Omics Sciences in Europe 2024
- Installable via pip: `pip install aestetik`
- MIT licensed, Python 3.9+, PyTorch Lightning-based

## When to Use AESTETIK

- You have spatial transcriptomics data (e.g., Visium) and want to learn biologically meaningful spot representations
- You want to integrate transcriptomics with H&E morphology features for downstream clustering or analysis
- You need to integrate multiple spatial transcriptomics samples across conditions or patients

## Related Projects

- [DeepSpot](https://github.com/ratschlab/DeepSpot): Predicts spatial transcriptomics from H&E images (uses AESTETIK for cross-sample integration)
- [DeepSpot2Cell](https://github.com/ratschlab/DeepSpot2Cell): Predicts virtual single-cell spatial transcriptomics from H&E images

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/ratschlab/aestetik
- Preprint: https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.06.04.24308256v1
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/aestetik/

## Installation

```
pip install aestetik
```

## Quick Start

AESTETIK is a scikit-learn-compatible estimator: it follows the
``fit`` / ``transform`` / ``predict`` / ``fit_transform`` /
``fit_predict`` surface. ``fit``, ``transform`` and ``predict`` do
**not** mutate the input AnnData; results land on the estimator as
trailing-underscore attributes (``embedding_``, ``labels_``, ...).

```python
from aestetik import AESTETIK

model = AESTETIK(
    n_cluster=adata.obs.ground_truth.unique().size,
    morphology_weight=1.5,
    window_size=3,
    clustering_method="kmeans",
)
model.fit(adata)
adata.obsm["AESTETIK"]        = model.transform(adata)
adata.obs["AESTETIK_cluster"] = model.predict(adata)

# Or in one shot:
adata.obs["AESTETIK_cluster"] = model.fit_predict(adata)
```

## Citation

Nonchev, K., Andani, S., Ficek-Pascual, J., Nowak, M., Sobottka, B., Tumor Profiler Consortium, Koelzer, V.H. and Rätsch, G. (2024). Representation learning for multi-modal spatially resolved transcriptomics data. medRxiv. DOI: 10.1101/2024.06.04.24308256
